    Long lines from the large-line theorem for ssc algebras #

    SSCNode is Bongartz's large-line theorem for simply connected sincere representation-finite algebras (BO13b, Theorem ssc), applied to the support of an indecomposable representation of a convex piece of the universal cover (the support of a directing module is convex, BO13b §1): an indecomposable whose support has at least 1000 points lives on a line with at least a sixth of that many points. Graded indecomposables with unbounded supports give such representations on convex hulls (grRep), so SSCNode gives LongLineNode (longLineNode_of_ssc).

    SSCNode is not proved in this library. The final proof does not use it: LongLineNode is proved directly in MainTheorems.lean.
